 1                P R O C E E D I N G S

 2                ACTING PRESIDENT SAVINO:   The 

 3   Senate will please come to order.  

 4                I ask all those present to please 

 5   rise with me and recite the Pledge of Allegiance.

 6                (Whereupon, the assemblage recited 

 7   the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

 8                ACTING PRESIDENT SAVINO:   Today's 

 9   invocation will be delivered by Apostle Leeds 

10   Jean of the True Vine Ministries/The Last Resort 

11   International, from Brooklyn, New York.

12                APOSTLE JEAN:   Praise God.  Good 

13   afternoon.  

14                Before I do this invocation, at this 

15   moment I would like you to put your heart 

16   together with me.  Last year, on February, I have 

17   lost my mother.  And following that few months, 

18   our Senator lost his mother as well.  And I think 

19   some of you might have gone through the same 

20   thing.  We're just going to take a moment right 

21   now for that.

22                (Whereupon, the assemblage respected 

23   a moment of silence.)

24                APOSTLE JEAN:   Thank you.

25                Our Father, we give You praise.  Our 


                                                                1211

 1   Father, we bless and magnify Your name.  We thank 

 2   You for being God.  We thank You for giving us 

 3   this moment to come together.  

 4                Father, as You have allowed me to be 

 5   in this place, as you allow me to sit in the 

 6   heavenly place within You, we pray to You now, 

 7   God, as I stand here in this place, that You, 

 8   Father, will grant us the wisdom, grant us that 

 9   we will do that which You have called us to do 

10   here in Jesus' mighty name.  

11                Lord, I pray to You now for each and 

12   every individual that is here within this room -- 

13   representing the city, representing the state, 

14   representing the nation, Father.  We pray to You 

15   for the individual families, God, my Father.  We 

16   speak now Your peace within this room.  We speak 

17   now Your peace over each and every one here.  We 

18   speak Your peace over each and every community 

19   that they represent here.  

20                Our Father, we pray that You will 

21   grant them the wisdom, grant them the wisdom and 

22   understanding, God, that they will carry out the 

23   assignments that enrich Your purpose and call 

24   them to carry out within this place.  

25                Father, I speak now to their DNA, 


                                                                1212

 1   according to the purpose in which they have been 

 2   called to be here, that, God, You will enable 

 3   them that they will do what is needed to be done 

 4   within this nation.

 5                Father, we pray to You, God, for the 

 6   individual communities which they represent now.  

 7   We pray to You for the individual cities and we 

 8   pray to You for the people that they represent, 

 9   the nations that they represent, Father, that You 

10   will enable them that they will meet the needs of 

11   the people within the communities.

12                Father, we pray to You now as they 

13   are about to deliver, as they are about to put on 

14   the floor the concerns, Father, that by the 

15   spirit of the Lord, by the spirit of counsel, 

16   God, You will empower them, You will give them 

17   the words to speak, You will give them the 

18   knowledge and the wisdom to articulate the words 

19   that they are to speak upon this floor here 

20   within this place, Father.  

21                We pray that You empower them, Lord.  

22   We pray that You will do it for Your glory and 

23   for Your purpose and for the purpose which you 

24   have established this nation, that this nation 

25   will remain a nation that people and cultures and 


                                                                1213

 1   nations will take pattern after.  We pray to You 

 2   now that You will do it, do it here.  

 3                Do it here, Father, and do it within 

 4   the various communities that they represent.  

 5   And, God, the people that comes within this 

 6   nation will see the way that you move with this 

 7   United States of America, that they may go into 

 8   the diverse nations and do likewise.  

 9                We pray to You that You will let 

10   this nation remain a shining nation, a shining 

11   place where people in cultural relation will come 

12   in and find a place that they desire to dwell in.  

13                We pray Your blessing upon each and 

14   every person here, upon their communities, and 

15   even upon this nation, Father.  And we thank you 

16   now, in Jesus' mightiest name.  

17                Amen.
